title: 第1024章 圣火再现第1023章 吃干抹净
content_zh:
而在他疯狂炼化的同时，金霄圣火深处那一缕原本潜藏的意志，也终于察觉到了不对。
嗡——！
祭坛之上，骤然响起一道低沉而冰冷的嗡鸣声。
那一瞬，原本还在疯狂挣扎的火焰余波猛地一滞，紧接着，一道年幼而漠然的声音，自广场上空缓缓回荡开来。
“圣火本源……被抹除了？”
声音虽然稚嫩，却带着一种极为古老的威严，仿佛来自这片秘境最深处的规则意志。
所有人闻声，脸色皆是一变。
“什么？！”秦烈猛地抬头，眼中满是震惊。
“本源被抹除？什么意思？”有人失声道。
蛮九荒目光骤缩，死死盯着半空中的叶霄炎，似乎已经猜到了什么。
就在众人惊疑不定之际，祭坛中心那团金焰之中，终于缓缓浮现出一道模糊的身影。
那身影并不凝实，像是由无数火焰符文交织而成，外形虽然只是幼童，双目却如金日般璀璨，周身散发着一种不容置疑的秩序气息。
他一出现，整片广场的火焰都仿佛受到了某种压制，纷纷向其俯伏。
“秘境之灵！”有人失声惊呼。
广场上顿时一片哗然。
叶霄炎缓缓抬眸，目光平静地看着那道火焰身影，心中却没有半分意外。
金霄出现之后，并未立刻看向其他人，而是直接将目光落在叶霄炎身上，声音淡漠无情。
“传承失败。”
四个字落下，场中气氛瞬间凝固。
“失败？”秦烈一怔。

“怎么会失败？”炎赤血目光骤然一沉。
“不是已经把金霄圣火吞了吗？”有人满脸不甘。
金霄神色没有任何波动，只是漠然道：“圣火本源已被抹除，传承根基不存，自然失败。”
说到这里，他抬起头，眼中金焰流转，淡淡补充了一句。
“金霄圣火，不承认此人。”
此话一出，宛如一记惊雷，狠狠劈在所有人心头。
不承认？
叶霄炎明明已经将圣火吞噬，甚至镇压了金霄火麟圣雀，最后却得到了这样的结果？
不少人先是一愣，随即眼中迅速浮现出复杂神色。
有震惊，有错愕，也有幸灾乐祸。
而最先反应过来的，却是蛮九荒和祝九炎等人。
他们本以为叶霄炎已经得到了最大好处，心中还存着不少忌惮，可如今秘境之灵亲口否认传承，意味着叶霄炎虽然吞了圣火，却并未真正成为其主。
这对他们而言，无疑是天大的机会。
“原来如此。”祝九炎目光微闪，嘴角缓缓掀起一抹冷意，“也就是说，真正的传承，还没有结束。”
“既然金霄圣火不承认他，那便说明我们还有机会。”炎赤血声音低沉，眼底血芒涌动。
蛮九荒更是直接咧嘴一笑，眼中凶光毕露：“好一个叶霄炎，折腾半天，最后还是白忙活。”
显然，他们已经打定主意，要重新争夺这道圣火。
而叶霄炎对这一切，却并没有出手阻止。
他只是静静立在半空，周身白金火焰缓缓收敛，神色间依旧带着一丝未曾散去的冷意。
因为他比任何人都清楚，这金霄圣火绝不简单。
content_en:
While he was refining frantically, the ray of will that was originally hidden deep in the Jinxiao Holy Fire finally realized that something was wrong.
Buzz—!
Above the altar, a low and cold buzz suddenly sounded.
At that moment, the aftermath of the flames that was still struggling like crazy suddenly stopped, and then, a young and indifferent voice slowly echoed from the sky above the square.
"The origin of the Holy Fire...has been erased?"
Although the voice is childish, it carries an extremely ancient majesty, as if coming from the deepest rules and will of this secret realm.
Everyone's expressions changed when they heard the sound.
"What?!" Qin Lie suddenly raised his head, his eyes full of shock.
"The origin has been erased? What do you mean?" Someone asked in a voiceless voice.
Man Jiuhuang's eyes narrowed suddenly and he stared at Ye Xiaoyan in mid-air, as if he had already guessed something.
Just when everyone was in shock and confusion, a vague figure finally slowly emerged from the golden flames in the center of the altar.
The figure was not solid, and seemed to be made up of countless flame runes intertwined. Although the appearance was just that of a young child, his eyes were as bright as the golden sun, and his whole body exuded an unquestionable aura of order.
As soon as he appeared, the flames in the entire square seemed to be suppressed in some way, and they all bowed down to him.
"The spirit of the secret realm!" someone exclaimed.
There was an uproar in the square.
Ye Xiaoyan slowly raised his eyes and looked at the flaming figure calmly, without any surprise in his heart.
After Jin Xiao appeared, he did not look at the others immediately, but directly focused his gaze on Ye Xiaoyan, his voice indifferent.
"Inheritance failed."
As soon as these four words fell, the atmosphere in the venue instantly solidified.
"Failed?" Qin Lie was startled.
"How could it fail?" Yan Chixue's eyes suddenly darkened.
"Hasn't it already swallowed up the Jinxiao Holy Fire?" Someone looked unwilling.
Jin Xiao's expression did not show any fluctuation, and he just said indifferently: "The origin of the Holy Fire has been wiped out, the foundation of the inheritance does not exist, and it will naturally fail."
Having said this, he raised his head, golden flames flowing in his eyes, and added lightly.
"Jinxiao Shenghuo does not recognize this person."
As soon as these words came out, it was like a thunder that struck everyone's heart.
Don’t admit it?
Ye Xiaoyan had clearly devoured the Holy Fire and even suppressed the Golden Sky Fire Lin Holy Bird, but in the end he got this result?
Many people were stunned at first, and then complex expressions quickly appeared in their eyes.
There was shock, astonishment, and gloating.
The first to react were Man Jiuhuang, Zhu Jiuyan and others.
They originally thought that Ye Xiaoyan had received the greatest benefit, and they still had a lot of fears in their hearts, but now the spirit of the secret realm personally denied the inheritance, which meant that although Ye Xiaoyan had swallowed the holy fire, he had not truly become its master.
This is undoubtedly a huge opportunity for them.
"I see." Zhu Jiuyan's eyes flashed slightly, and a coldness slowly appeared at the corner of his mouth, "In other words, the real inheritance is not over yet."
"Since Jinxiao Shenghuo doesn't recognize him, it means we still have a chance." Yan Chixue's voice was low, and his eyes were filled with blood.
Man Jiuhuang grinned directly, with a fierce look in his eyes: "What a Ye Xiaoyan, he worked hard for a long time, but in the end his work was in vain."
Obviously, they have made up their minds to compete for this sacred fire again.
But Ye Xiaoyan did not stop all this.
He just stood quietly in mid-air, with the platinum flames around him slowly fading away, and there was still a trace of coldness in his expression that had not dissipated.
Because he knows better than anyone else that this Golden Sky Holy Fire is anything but simple.
